import json, random
rnd = random.Random(1234)
specs = []

    specs.append({"kind":"big","seed":200+i,
                  "viol": rnd.choice([0.02,0.08,0.15,0.3,0.5,0.75]),
                  "wide": rnd.choice([True,False]),
                  "cap_scale": rnd.choice([1.0,1.2,2.0,5.0]),
                  "ndoms": nd,
                  "max_faults": rnd.randint(1,nd),
                  "ncoms": rnd.choice([2,6,11,12]),
                  "nedges": rnd.choice([5,12,20,32]),
                  "nsnap": rnd.choice([1,2,3,4]),
                  "nobs": rnd.choice([16,64,128,256])})
json.dump(specs, open('specs2.json','w'))
json.dump(specs[:7], open('s2a.json','w'))
json.dump(specs[7:14], open('s2b.json','w'))
json.dump(specs[14:], open('s2c.json','w'))
EOF
